name: surprise_s3c_base_manifest_404_after_crash
covers: surprise 3, the recovery route: a page reads the commit key and, before it reads the manifest the key names, a recovery installs a staged copy under a new commit key, its fence is discarded and a collection pass deletes the old trees; the page's manifest read finds the unit gone, and the boot decides the recovery screen (row 6, tree missing) instead of building on the stale key

labels.A: begin ordinary commit; A: upload u; A: a: the page that reloads: open reads the fence and the commit key (current is the seeded manifest) and then reads the manifest; that read is held
labels.B: ordinary commit: b: a commit after a's read of the commit key; admit moves the clock, so its manifest is the newest candidate
labels.RECOVER: read commit key; candidate list: r: recover once b's commit is applied: the exit's fence write and marker, the tree read, the staged copy and the final write, which names the staged manifest and an empty retained list
labels.GC: pass; GC: remove [m/0]: g: once r has discarded the fence (a recovery's fence lists every key and keeps a pass from deleting them), a collection pass: read commit key, mark, fence, list, retire of the old trees; the pass is the step that releases a's held read
labels.A: read manifest m/0 -> missing; re-read: a: the manifest read finds nothing; open classifies the boot as the recovery screen, row 6 with the tree missing
labels.recovery screen of that boot: a: recover, which runs on the commit key read the boot made: its marker write is made at that read's token, conflicts because r's install moved the key on, and the exit is abandoned (recover:pick:exit:abandoned). r opens only after b's commit, so that its own boot read is the key it installs over
